scope: Public authored pull requests, opened issues, reviews of other authors’ pull requests, and indexed authored commits outside personal repositories. Includes employer and community collaboration.
methodology: Searches have no lower date cutoff for pull requests, issues, or reviews. Commit search covers account creation in 2008 through 2026; date ranges were partitioned below GitHub’s 1,000-result search limit and all pages retrieved.
Only is:public results are included. Naturah and Stack Paper are excluded at the owner’s request.

Commit search returned 1,615 repository/commit matches (549 distinct SHAs). Known upstream repositories are retained, duplicate SHAs are counted once, and inherited copies in other repositories are not treated as separate contributions.
Commit records overlap pull requests: their counts must not be added together. Commits include merge commits; GitHub search is not a complete Git log.
Reviews link to verified submissions by mager, grouped by pull request. Pull request states and issue states are a dated snapshot.
Deleted/private repositories, unindexed or unattributed commits, issue comments, and discussions are not covered. Public visibility does not establish an open-source license.
